title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - TroubleTicket
description: A trouble ticket is a record of an issue that is created, tracked, and managed by a trouble ticket management system (TM Forum TMF621 Trouble Ticket 5.0.1, OpenAPI component TroubleTicket; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:TroubleTicket:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TroubleTicket'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'TroubleTicket' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Addressable/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:TroubleTicket:<tmfId>. unique identifier

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/name'. Name of the trouble ticket, typically a short description provided by the user that create the ticket

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/description'. Description of the trouble or issue

severity.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/severity'. The severity of the issue. Indicate the implication of the issue on the expected functionality e.g. of a system, application, service etc.. Severity values can be for example : Critical, Major, Minor

ticketType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/ticketType'. Represent a business type of the trouble ticket e.g. incident, complain, request

attachment.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/attachment'. File(s) attached to the trouble ticket. e.g. picture of broken device, scanning of a bill or charge

channel.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/channel'. The channel to which the resource reference to. e.g. channel for selling product offerings, channel for opening a trouble ticket etc..

creationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/creationDate'. The date on which the trouble ticket was created

requestedResolutionDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/requestedResolutionDate'. The resolution date requested by the user

expectedResolutionDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/expectedResolutionDate'. The expected resolution date determined by the trouble ticket system

resolutionDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/resolutionDate'. The date and time the trouble ticket was resolved

externalIdentifier.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/externalIdentifier'. An identification of an entity that is owned by or originates in a software system different from the current system, for example a ProductOrder handed off from a commerce platform into an order handling system. The structure identifies the system itself, the nature of the entity within the system (e.g. class name) and the unique ID of the entity within the system. It is anticipated that multiple external IDs can be held for a single entity, e.g. if the entity passed through multiple systems on the way to the current system. In this case the consumer is expected to sequence the IDs in the array in reverse order of provenance, i.e. most recent system first in the list.

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/lastUpdate'. The date and time that the trouble ticket was last updated

note.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/note'. The note(s) that are associated to the ticket.

priority.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/priority'. The priority of the trouble ticket and how quickly the issue should be resolved. Example: Critical, High, Medium, Low. The value is set by the ticket management system considering the severity, ticket type etc...

relatedEntity.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/relatedEntity'. An entity that is related to the ticket such as a bill, a product, etc. The entity against which the ticket is associated.

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/relatedParty'. The related party(ies) that are associated to the ticket.

status.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/status'. Possible values for the status of the trouble ticket

statusChangeDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/statusChangeDate'. The date and time the status changed.

statusChangeReason.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/statusChangeReason'. The reason for changing the status

statusChangeHistory.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/statusChangeHistory'. The status change history that are associated to the ticket. Populated by the server

troubleTicketRelationship.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/troubleTicketRelationship'. A list of trouble ticket relationships (TroubleTicketRelationship [*]). Represents a relationship between trouble tickets

troubleTicketSpecification.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF621_TroubleTicket/blob/v5.0.0/TMF621-Trouble_Ticket-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/TroubleTicket/properties/troubleTicketSpecification'. reference to an TroubleTicketSpecification object. In TMF this is a TroubleTicketSpecificationRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced TroubleTicketSpecification entity (urn:ngsi-ld:TroubleTicketSpecification:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.
